description: Medium-density performance line Arm Cortex-M3 MCU, 72 MHz, 64 or 128 KB Flash (x8 = 64 KB), 20 KB SRAM, USB, CAN, 2x 12-bit ADC, 2.0-3.6 V supply. Source: ST DS5319 Rev 18 (Mar 2022).

pinout.name: VBAT
pinout.notes: Backup-domain supply 1.8-3.6 V: RTC, 32 kHz osc, backup registers via power switch when VDD absent [2.3.9]

pinout.name: PC13-TAMPER-RTC
pinout.notes: After reset: PC13. Supplied through power switch: sink max 3 mA, output <= 2 MHz with max 30 pF load, must not be used as current source e.g. to drive a LED [Table 5 note 5]

pinout.name: PC14-OSC32_IN
pinout.notes: After reset: PC14. LSE 32.768 kHz crystal input. Same power-switch limits as PC13 [Table 5 note 5]

pinout.name: PC15-OSC32_OUT
pinout.notes: After reset: PC15. LSE 32.768 kHz crystal output. Same power-switch limits as PC13 [Table 5 note 5]

pinout.name: OSC_IN
pinout.notes: HSE crystal/external clock input (crystal 4-16 MHz). Configured as OSC_IN after reset; PD0 available by software remap [Table 5 note 7]

pinout.name: OSC_OUT
pinout.notes: HSE crystal output. Configured as OSC_OUT after reset; PD1 available by software remap [Table 5 note 7]

pinout.name: NRST
pinout.notes: Active-low reset, permanent internal pull-up RPU 30-50 kOhm (typ 40k). Recommended protection: 0.1 uF capacitor to ground [Figure 31, Table 38]

pinout.name: VSSA
pinout.notes: Analog ground; must be connected to VSS [2.3.9]. On LQFP48 VREF- is internally connected to VSSA [Table 46 note 3]

pinout.name: VDDA
pinout.notes: Analog supply 2.0-3.6 V (min 2.4 V when ADC used); must be connected to VDD [2.3.9]. On LQFP48 VREF+ is internally connected to VDDA [Table 46 note 3]

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to the chip
decoupling.notes: Figure 14 power supply scheme shows 5 x 100 nF + 1 x 4.7 uF across VDD_1..5 (100-pin device); LQFP48 has 3 VDD pins -> one 100 nF each
Caution in 5.1.6: 'the 4.7 uF capacitor must be connected to VDD3'

decoupling.placement: 10 nF ceramic (good quality) placed as close as possible to the chip
decoupling.notes: Figure 40 (VREF+ internally connected to VDDA case, applies to LQFP48) and 5.3.18 General PCB design guidelines
Recommended NRST pin protection [Figure 31]; reset network protects against parasitic resets; internal pull-up RPU 30-50 kOhm (typ 40k)

land_pattern.notes: From Figure 63 recommended footprint (mm): pad tip-to-tip extent 9.70, inner edge-to-edge 7.30 (row_spacing 8.50 = center-to-center, derived as (9.70+7.30)/2), pad row extent 5.80 per side (12 pads/side), 0.20 gap between adjacent pads, pad 0.30 wide x 1.20 long. Package mechanical (Table 61): body D1xE1 = 7.0 x 7.0, lead span DxE = 9.0 x 9.0, lead width b 0.17-0.27, height A max 1.60

layout_notes: HSE crystal (4-16 MHz): resonator and load capacitors placed as close as possible to the oscillator pins to minimize output distortion and startup stabilization time [5.3.6]

HSE load caps CL1/CL2: high-quality ceramic 5-25 pF (typ) designed for high-frequency, matched to crystal; include PCB+pin capacitance (~10 pF rough estimate) when sizing; REXT depends on crystal; see AN2867 [5.3.6]
LSE 32.768 kHz: CL1/CL2 high-quality ceramic 5-15 pF, close to pins; use a resonator with load capacitance CL <= 7 pF; never use a 12.5 pF load resonator [5.3.6 caution]
Power decoupling per Figure 14/40: 100 nF per VDD pin + 4.7 uF on VDD_3; VDDA: 1 uF // 10 nF; the 10 nF caps ceramic good quality as close as possible to the chip [5.3.18]
VDDA/VSSA must be connected to VDD/VSS respectively [2.3.9]; power VDD and VDDA from the same source; max 300 mV VDD-VDDA difference tolerated during power-up and operation [Table 9 note 2]
All main power (VDD, VDDA) and ground (VSS, VSSA) pins must always be connected to the external power supply in the permitted range [Table 6 note 1]
Keep variations between VDD power pins < 50 mV and between ground pins < 50 mV [Table 6]
NRST: internal permanent pull-up; add 0.1 uF to ground (recommended protection network); external reset must be able to pull NRST below VIL(NRST) max 0.8 V [Figure 31, Table 38]
PC13/PC14/PC15 are supplied through the power switch: sink limited to 3 mA, output use limited to 2 MHz / 30 pF, must not be used as a current source (e.g. LED drive) [Table 5 note 5]

ADC: external input impedance RAIN <= 50 kOhm max (depends on sampling time, Table 47); PCB parasitic capacitance on analog inputs degrades accuracy; add a Schottky diode to ground on analog pins that may inject negative current [5.3.18, Table 48/49 notes]
ADC: recommended to perform a calibration after each power-up; VDDA 2.4-3.6 V when ADC used [5.3.18]
5 V tolerant (FT) I/Os sustaining voltage > VDD+0.3 V require internal pull-up/pull-down disabled [Table 9 note 3, Table 35 note 3]
Boot: BOOT0 (pin 44) + BOOT1 (PB2) select boot from user Flash / System memory / embedded SRAM at startup; bootloader in System memory uses USART1 [2.3.8]
Thermal: LQFP48 theta-JA = 55 degC/W; PD max 363 mW at TA=85 degC (suffix 6) [Table 62, Table 9]
